I could build two houses on each pink for $600, leaving only $208, but that's risky since oranges with four houses could charge $700-750 in rent and I'm about to roll into that danger zone near St James, Tennessee, and New York.

Since I rolled doubles, this is a post-jail action and my turn ends regardless, so I don't get another roll to worry about. Building just one house each costs $300, leaves $508, and I'd still have mortgage/house-sale liquidity (North Carolina, Boardwalk, plus selling back houses) to cover a hit if I land on an orange—so that feels like the safer compromise versus going all-in on two houses each.

I keep going back and forth, but for safety I'll settle on 1 each — it keeps liquidity tighter against worst-case rents like NY or Tennessee, even though 2 each would get more built faster.
